visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands wearing plastic gloves holds a whole, golden-brown fried chicken over a white cardboard box. The chicken skin is heavily seasoned with red and black powder. (2) The hands tear the chicken apart from the center, revealing steaming, white, juicy meat underneath the crispy exterior. (3) Raw whole chicken is shown being dipped into a large bin of white batter or flour, then submerged into a deep fryer filled with bubbling, hot golden oil. (4) Metal tongs lift the perfectly fried, orange-gold whole chicken out of the fryer, with oil dripping from its limbs. (5) The fried chicken is placed into a box labeled 'CHICKEN' in red text. A hand presses on the crispy skin to show its texture. (6) A chicken leg is pulled away from the body, showing a glistening, moist texture and steam rising. (7) A whole fried chicken is placed on a charcoal grill; a brush is used to apply a glossy dark brown sauce over the surface while white smoke billows around it. (8) The grilled chicken is cut into bite-sized pieces with a large knife, showing sesame seeds on the surface. (9) Various side dishes, including fried green beans and tofu skin, are shaken in a stainless steel bowl with seasoning powder. (10) Close-up shots of individual fried items: a chicken bone piece, a strip of crispy chicken skin, a layered tofu skin, and a fried king oyster mushroom held by wooden skewers. (11) A wide shot of the food stall storefront featuring a large banner with '友炸炸雞' and a menu board listed with various items and prices.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 female main creator (hands only), 1 male stall worker (partially visible)
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: The main person is only visible through their hands, which are wearing transparent plastic food-handling gloves.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video shifts between extreme close-ups of food in boxes and the industrial kitchen environment of a street-side fried chicken stall, featuring deep fryers, grills, and stainless steel prep tables.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Enthusiastic male narration begins over an upbeat electronic pop track. A sudden wet, squelching sound triggers as chicken parts are torn apart. (2) A high-frequency bubbling and sizzling sound of hot oil becomes dominant as chicken enters the fryer. (3) A metallic click and scraping sound occurs as tongs hit the side of the fryer. (4) A low-frequency thud and box rustling sound as the chicken is placed into cardboard packaging. (5) A sharp, high-pitched hissing sound of steam and grilling metal follows. (6) Brushing sounds (friction) and mechanical chopping noises are heard as the food is processed. (7) Rhythmic metallic rattling as items are tossed in a stainless steel bowl with dry seasoning hits. (8) Quick, high-arousal narration continues until the final sign-off with the BGM fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Showcase -> Cooking Process -> Menu Variation -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a specific fried chicken stall in Kaohsiung by highlighting the visual appeal of their signature 'whole fried chicken.' It uses high-energy editing and close-up 'food porn' imagery to emphasize the juiciness and crispiness of the products to attract customers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video includes the brand logo, specific address, menu details, and a direct recommendation from the creators.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes synchronized SFX and rapid visual cuts to create a sensory-heavy experience common in social media food marketing.
